Ṛktantra
Ṛk. t. vyākaraṇa or Chandogavyākaraṇa; a Prātiśākhya of Sv., Kauthumaśākhā, ascribed in some authorities to Śākaṭāyana an. in some others to Audavraji with a C., but beyond 1st Prapāṭhaka mss. give only the Sūtras.
Adyar I. p. 48b. Adyar D. I. 760. Alwar 285. Baroda 9805 (a.. 12912 (a.. 12917 (c) (with C.). BBRAS. 483. BC. 437. Bhau Dāji 62. Bikaner 620. BISM. v.. 982/22. BORI. 10 of 1869-70. 92 of 1879-80. BORI. D. II. i. 1. 2. Brahmacāri Wāḍi 29. CLB. I. p. 23. p. 24 (2 mss.). D. p.. 6. 131. Gough p. 64. Mad. Uni. R. A. S. 173 (a.. Mysore I. p. 24. Oxf. 378a. Oxf. II. 855 (12). P. 6. Peters. II. p. 180 (no. 56). SB. 9 (1-4 prapāṭhakas). Trav. Uni. 1733A. 5980A (with C.). 11824 B. C.
Edn.. (1) Burnell, Mangalore, 1879. (2) Suryakanta, Lahore, 1933.
--C. Bhāṣya. Trav. Uni. 5980A. 11824C.
--C. Vivṛti. Adyar I. p. 48b. Adyar D. I. 761. Baroda 12917. CLB. I. p. 24. IO. 4323. Trav. Uni. 11824B.
Ed.. See the two edns. of text noted above; IO. notes that its ms. differs partly. Suryakanta's edn. has used the Adyar ms.

Ṛktantraparibhāṣāśeṣa
Ed.. Suryakanta, a. beg. of his edn. of Laghuṛktantrasaṅgraha, Lahore, 1940. Based on a single ms. in the Chandra Shumsher Col.., Bodleian Library, Oxford.

Ṛktantrapariśiṣṭa
the avagraha portion of the Ṛk.t. Ed.., Suryakanta, Woolner Com. Vol., Lahore, 1940, a. end, p.. 321-28. [Page005-b]

Ṛktantrasaṅgraha
Adyar I. p. 45b. See Laghuṛktantrasaṅgraha.
